title: Pros: Free, works with Google Calendar. Cons: Everything else
body:
If you use Google calendar, and want a free, bare-bones To-Do List app that will show up on said calendar - this is that, and almost only that.

If you need a well-designed task app, that does anything else other than that: flee. 

Leaving aside that Google is the Internet equivalent of an all-seeing, all-knowing, amoral God, moonlighting as a giant billboard: 

• No search function (this is Google we’re talking about.)
• Recurring tasks completely disappear from the app if they are not currently due, so you can’t look ahead to see what recurring tasks you have coming up - though you can find them individually by searching in Google Calendar. Why Google Calendar has a search function that works on Tasks, while Tasks doesn’t, is beyond me
• Tasks can only have one set of subtasks - which cannot be hidden
• Longer Task notes get visually truncated, so you can’t see past a certain point
• No tags or hierarchical sorting
• Can’t rearrange the order of your Lists in the app, you have to do it via the web app
• Un-deletable ‘default’ list - as such, I recommend not using it 
• Recently added feature of “Due Dates” don’t seem to provide any sort of visual feedback in the app, not sure if they do in GC, also Due Dates are not editable in calendar despite being…dates
• I’m sure there was more…

Again, this is a Google app. A handful of small meaningful changes would put this squarely top of the heap, like most Google apps. But here we are.

title: duration of tasks
body:
I quickly found out every task is considered as a 30 minute time frame in your Google calendar. This is ridiculous because you can create lists with a date or time, but not a due date or specific duration. Duration for my purpose isn't important because events cover that, but making a task exactly 30 minutes makes it useless as a checklist for important deadlines. Reminders were better for that, but unfortunately you couldn't load it with more subtasks or details besides a time. It's awful google has you convert all your reminders into tasks without explaining this. I set a task for an assignment for a couple minutes before midnight so I have a list of due dates and so it would be on my schedule. Unfortunately on my schedule it has two parts for the end of day 1 and the start of day two for the remainder of the default 30 minute time frame. This is not a well thought out use for tasks and they are trying to replace a useful feature with something less useful. This is especially upsetting because they want to charge to allow businesses or professionals to have clients schedule directly ywoth their calendar, but you would have to use something different to create due dates. This will force users out of their walled garden. Apparently this hasn't changed in three years because there are posts talking about this 30 minute issue in 2020.

So my question is what I'm saying correct? Is there a fix coming down the pipeline, or has anyone come up with a proper productivity solution within google's systems (calendar/keep/tasks/etcetera)?

1. Would love to be able to set the ‘order by date’ setting as default rather than having to set it individually for each list

2. It would be helpful if you could set new tasks to be allocated to today’s date by default. It’s a pain to have to select a date for each task you add. It would also be nice to be able to drag and drop a task from today to a different date, rather than having to edit the task and select a new date.

3. I’d like to be able to see my completed tasks ‘crossed out’ or ‘ticked’ on the active list rather than it automatically disappearing onto the completed list...I like to be able to see what I’ve completed as well as what I have left to complete.

4. The ‘completed tasks’ list would be better if it could also be separated by date in the same way as the active list, then it would be easy to see what has been completed on a specific day

title: Still needs work!!
body:
For several years I was happily using another app integrated to Google tasks.  Sadly the developer didn’t update it to latest Google standards so I’ve had to swap to using native app.

My frustrations:
- Badge not working for me so I keep missing tasks.  Amazing how much the badge count reminds you after dismissing reminder.
- I used to have daily tasks like paying for car parking.  As my needs are a difficult pattern, the other app was so much better.  It would generate next task upon marking current one completed and I could then mark future tasks complete immediately ie buy 3 days of car parking, Mark 3 days complete.  Google just generates on the day so you never really get a decent view of upcoming tasks in the app.

I’m seriously thinking of ditching Google Tasks now and moving to Microsoft as their app is so much better for my needs.
